selection: First published interval of each video; two seconds centered on the median observed single-person frame
scope: Evaluate existing temporal AVA walk and run/jog evidence; no new model or trained weights
policyOrigin: Existing measuredWalking gates; run policy uses the same gates with walk/run indices exchanged, frozen before AVA holdout inference
confidenceMeaning: Evidence strength, not calibrated probability; do not relabel raw sigmoid outputs as calibrated confidence
unavailableHandling: Retain every planned source; absent eligible boxes are unknown and count as misses for positive actions
